title: Functional and dysfunctional T regulatory cell states in human tissues in RA and other autoimmune arthritic diseases
description: This study includes newly generated regulatory T cell datasets derived from peripheral blood and synovial fluid samples obtained from adult patients with rheumatoid arthritis. These samples were collected and processed for flow cytometry and single-cell transcriptomic analyses. Additional datasets analyzed in the associated manuscript, including synovial tissue and healthy donor blood samples, were obtained from previously published public repositories and are not part of this dbGaP deposition.
